name: JWT Block
description: A block that outputs a signed JWT for the current user/context.
project_description:
The JWT Block is a module that contains a block with a link to an endpoint using a JWT Token, extending this block you can change the payload of the token.

 Works with Key and JSON Web Token Authentication (JWT) modules.

 Back to top 

 Known issues 
 Right now and until this issue ( https://www.drupal.org/project/jwt_block/issues/3196850 ) is fixed it just supports JWE encryption.

Is dependent on JWT module and supported encription is hard-coded until this issue is fixed https://www.drupal.org/project/jwt_block/issues/3196853 

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 Modules:

 
 Key 
 JSON Web Token Authentication (JWT) 
 
 PHP Extensions:

 
 Requires the GMP PHP extension.
